items.summary: Replace the current TanStack Router setup in `frontend/src/App.tsx` with `react-router-dom` hash routing by explicitly importing `HashRouter`, `Routes`, and `Route` from `react-router-dom`, wrapping the app in `<HashRouter>`, and defining exactly these routes: `<Route path="/" element={<Home />} />` and `<Route path="/wishes" element={<AdminWishes />} />`.

Verify and fix routing behavior so that navigating directly to `https://cutiepie-uhp.caffeine.xyz/#/wishes` (or locally `/#/wishes`) does not show the homepage content as a fallback, and the admin wishes page is the only rendered page content for that route.
